vision-manual band3/4 2026-07-27: vision 2026-08-24, ANNUAL minus NINE-MONTH from the filer's OWN two filings, same line, same basis (Rs Lacs, Standalone Parent). Annual 'AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE YEAR ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2011': Total Income (1) = 491,854 = 4,918.54 (net sales 485,040 + other operating income 6,814). Nine-month 'UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE THIRD QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2011': Total Income (1) 9M = 380,740 = 3,807.40 (377,927 + 2,813). Q4 = 4,918.54 - 3,807.40 = 1,111.14 (net sales 1,071.13 + other op 40.01). ★ THE SAME SUBTRACTION VALIDATES ITSELF ON PAT: 9M net profit 13,183 lacs = 131.83, annual 1,200 lacs = 12.00, so Q4 = 12.00 - 131.83 = -119.83 == stored npStd EXACT. The BSE auto-parser had produced 4,112.32 = TOTAL INCOME, the wrong line for a bank.

con.retracted: FY18 ANNUAL figures stored in the 2018-03 QUARTER slot. The consolidated XBRL of the 12-Jun-2018 submission (INDAS_35021_9038_11052018113258_WEB_2.xml) tags the SAME value on its quarter context and its year context — OneD 2018-01-01..2018-03-31 and FourD 2017-04-01..2018-03-31 both carry RevenueFromOperations 2719.35 and ProfitLossForPeriod 400.14 — while the standalone twin (_WEB.xml) distinguishes them correctly (OneD 700.41 / 237.86, FourD 2719.35 / 400.57). NSE's results-data row repeats the annual as 'Non-Cumulative' too. The filing's own consolidated statement is titled 'for TWELVE MONTHS ended 31 March 2018 and 31 March 2017' and prints NO quarter column, and no consolidated filing exists for any other FY18 quarter, so no Q4FY18 consolidated figure exists to correct to and it is not derivable. Retracted to null rather than assumed equal to the standalone 700.41.

PAT row 13 = 921.41 lacs = 9.2141 == stored npStd 9.21. Moneycontrol reports 267.65, which is EXACTLY the net-sales line (a) alone - our convention is the (a+b) TOTAL row, as on every other cell read this session (TORNTPOWER, THERMAX, DHAMPURSUG, TEXRAIL).

vision-manual band3/4 2026-07-27: vision 2026-08-24, YEAR-LATER comparative: 'INEOS STYROLUTION INDIA LIMITED, FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND YEAR ENDED MARCH 31, 2017' (INR in Lakhs), column 'quarter ended March 31, 2016 (Audited)': row I Revenue from operations = 42,409.28 lakhs = 424.09 (row III Total income 42,448.65 = 424.49 adds non-operating other income 39.37 and is NOT our line - build_revop stores the RevenueFromOperations tag). Row VII Profit for the year = 2,655.01 lakhs = 26.5501 == stored npStd 26.55. ★ VINTAGE MATTERS HERE MORE THAN USUAL: the company's OWN earlier Mar-2016 filing shows that quarter as 76,745.83 lacs = 767.46 with PAT 3,324.76 = 33.25, because (its notes 8-9) those figures are BALANCING figures that fold in 12 months of the amalgamated Styrolution India Pvt Ltd. Our stored PAT 26.55 matches the RESTATED Ind-AS comparative, so the restated revenue is the matching vintage. Reading the earlier filing would have overstated this cell by ~81%.
